cards.card_text: The house of Israel calls the bread manna, and it’s white like coriander seed.
cards.verse_text: Now the house of Israel called the bread manna.
cards.snippet: Now the house of Israel called the bread manna.

cards.card_text: Moses says the LORD has commanded them to keep an omer of manna.
cards.verse_text: Moses said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see the bread I fed you in the wilderness when I brought you out of the land of Egypt.’”
cards.snippet: …said, “This is what the LORD has commanded: ‘Keep an omer of manna for the generations to come, so that they may see the bread…

cards.card_text: So Aaron fills a jar with an omer of manna and places it in front of the Testimony, to be preserved just as the LORD commanded Moses.
cards.verse_text: So Moses told Aaron, “Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna.
cards.snippet: …told Aaron, “Take a jar and fill it with an omer of manna.

cards.card_text: The Israelites eat manna until they reach the border of Canaan, for forty ___.
cards.verse_text: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land where they could settle; they ate manna until they reached the border of Canaan.
cards.snippet: The Israelites ate manna forty years, until they came to a land where they could settle;…

cards.card_text: The people say their appetite is gone and there's nothing to see out here but the manna.
cards.verse_text: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”
cards.snippet: …now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”

cards.verse_text: Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.
cards.snippet: Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.

cards.card_text: True or false: the manna fell on the camp with the dew at night.
cards.verse_text: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.
cards.snippet: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.

cards.verse_text: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
cards.snippet: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that…

cards.card_text: Moses says the manna was meant to teach Israel that people don't live on bread alone.
cards.verse_text: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that you might understand that man does not live on bread alone, but on every word that comes from the mouth of the LORD.
cards.snippet: He humbled you, and in your hunger He gave you manna to eat, which neither you nor your fathers had known, so that…

cards.card_text: He fed them with manna their fathers had never known, to humble them and test them.
cards.verse_text: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and test you, so that in the end He might cause you to prosper.
cards.snippet: He fed you in the wilderness with manna that your fathers had not known, in order to humble you and…

cards.card_text: The manna The quail The cloud
cards.verse_text: And the day after they had eaten from the produce of the land, the manna ceased.
cards.snippet: …day after they had eaten from the produce of the land, the manna ceased.

cards.card_text: God gives His good Spirit to instruct them, keeps the manna coming and gives them water for their thirst.
cards.verse_text: You did not withhold Your manna from their mouths, and You gave them water for their thirst.
cards.snippet: You did not withhold Your manna from their mouths, and You gave them water for their thirst.

cards.verse_text: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
cards.snippet: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.

cards.verse_text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”

cards.card_text: Jesus says their fathers who ate the manna in the wilderness never died.
cards.verse_text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
cards.snippet: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.

cards.card_text: And He comes back to the manna: their fathers ate it and died, but the one who eats this bread will live forever.
cards.verse_text: Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”
cards.snippet: Unlike your fathers, who ate the manna and died, the one who eats this bread will live forever.”

cards.card_text: That's where the gold-covered ark of the covenant sat, holding the stone tablets, the gold jar of manna and the budded staff of Aaron, Israel's first high priest.
cards.verse_text: Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.
cards.snippet: Inside the ark were the gold jar of manna, Aaron’s staff that had budded, and the stone tablets of the covenant.

cards.card_text: Then a promise to the one who overcomes: the hidden manna.
cards.verse_text: To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna.
cards.snippet: To the one who overcomes, I will give the hidden manna.
